t: This Is What Winning Looks Like (Full Length)

q.x: For a fascinating insight into the disaster that was supposed to be the training of and transition to local security forces, I highly recommend the 2013 documentary "This Is What Winning Looks Like": [link]

desc:
"This Is What Winning Looks Like" is a disturbing new documentary about the ineptitude, drug abuse, sexual misconduct, and corruption of the Afghan security forces as well as the reduced role of US Marines due to the troop withdrawal.

Read the full article here: http://www.vice.com/read/this-is-what-winning-looks-like-0000111-v20n5

Follow @BenJohnAnderson on Twitter here: https://twitter.com/Ben
